purpose: Buy resolution on the three tiers the frozen 400 left unresolved. On n = 50 per tier the official scorer gave tier 2 74.0 against a published 84.6, tier 5 78.0 against 90.6 and tier 8 34.0 against 41.7 -- all 'not aligned', all inside a CI90 of about +/-11 pp that cannot separate a 3-point rule. This run repeats the tier-1 official-population recipe unchanged on exactly those tiers: 500 queries per tier from each tier's own released population (the paper code's first-successful-speaker rule), one roster, one split identity hash, one cell, tier as the stratum. The protocol is untouched -- the request is byte-identical to R-official-raw and T1-official-pop-500. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-04-a2t-tier258-official-population-v1-preregistration.md.

weakest_published_speechlm.note: Audio-Flamingo-8B on tier 2; the weakest published SpeechLM row on each tier

A2T-TIER258-OFFICIAL-POP-1500.selection: each tier's released population (the first recording the released loader resolves in every query_* directory), sampled uniformly without replacement, seed 20260803, via random.Random(seed).sample over that tier's population in ascending manifest-id order. max_samples was NOT used: the release orders every subset smart_home -> wearables -> smart_car, so the first 500 sorted directories would be a near-pure smart_home sample on tiers 2 and 5.
A2T-TIER258-OFFICIAL-POP-1500.estimand: per-tier tool accuracy on each tier's own released population, estimated from a uniform 500-query sample per tier

cells.factor: population and n: each tier's own released population at n = 500 instead of 50 stratified mixed-speaker rows
cells.factor_a_output_contract: unchanged from R-official-raw and T1-official-pop-500: the published system message (the adapter's hard-coded default prompt, the fixed '## Available Tools:' header, and format_tools_compact over the whole 152-row registry)
cells.user_turn: audio first, then the fixed sentence 'Convert this voice command to a tool call.'
cells.serving_geometry: -c 49152 -np 3, 16,384 tokens per slot -- the same geometry R-official-raw and W-official-raw-yaml flew. The longest wav of this roster is 32.43375 s (tier5_needle:003555), so the worst request needs 3,581 + 429 + 256 + 2 = 4,268 tokens and nothing forces the tier-1 cell's -np 2.

shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py -- the same harness and the same entry point every calibration, replication and official-population cell flew
shared_protocol.per_cell_dataset_fragment: this run's single cell is launched with --dataset audio2tool-tier258-official-population-1500; the runner composes model + dataset + baseline + experiment exactly as every earlier Audio2Tool direct cell did

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 1,500 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 1,508; the registered exposure ceiling is 1,560
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 9,784.337875 s for one pass, rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires (9,785); the registered exposure ceiling is 9,900
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 1.0; T1-official-pop-500 flew 500 raw rows in 282 s of generation at -np 2, and this cell is 1,500 rows at -np 3 with a longest wav of 32.4 s. The registered ceiling is 1.5
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values

metrics: official tool accuracy (primary gold tool), per tier, with a Wilson CI90 at n = 500
official parameter precision/recall/F1, macro over samples as the published code computes it
parameter F1 micro-pooled, reported beside the macro figure
a2t-toolcall-v2 ordered tool accuracy, exact match and slot F1 under the extended parse
mandatory_slices: per tier: tool accuracy, exact match and parameter F1 with a Wilson CI90 at n = 500, against the paper's row and against the Qwen-2.5-Omni-7B and weakest-published-SpeechLM floors
per tier by domain (smart_home / wearables / smart_car), natural mixture and equal-domain
tier 8 under BOTH the official first-call rule and a2t-toolcall-v2's ordered rule, with the count of rows whose response named more than one call
each tier against the frozen 400's own 50 rows of that tier, so the population effect is a difference rather than a replacement
official scorer versus the extended a2t-toolcall-v2 on the same outputs, per tier, with the rule behind any gap larger than 3 points named
parse rate and the count of rows whose response named more than one call

decision.owner_alignment_standard: 2026-09-04 owner directive, restated 2026-09-04 for this flight: aligned means within 3 points of the official number, and being better than the official number by more than 3 points is also acceptable. The number is a2t-toolcall-official's tool accuracy.

per_tier_rule.aligned: ALIGNED: official tool accuracy >= paper - 3.0 (tier 2 >= 81.6, tier 5 >= 87.6, tier 8 >= 38.7), or better than the paper.
per_tier_rule.consistent_within_noise: CONSISTENT-WITHIN-NOISE: not ALIGNED, but the paper value lies inside the Wilson score CI90 for a binomial proportion at n = 500.

decision.floor_rule: Reported for every tier whatever the outcome: our number against Qwen-2.5-Omni-7B (tier 2 80.6, tier 5 74.1, tier 8 36.5) and against the weakest published SpeechLM row (tier 2 75.3 Audio-Flamingo-8B, tier 5 58.9, tier 8 30.4). A tier below a degraded model's published number is called out explicitly.
decision.power_note: n = 500 per tier gives a binomial standard error of 1.6 pp at p = 0.85, 1.3 pp at p = 0.91 and 2.2 pp at p = 0.42, so the 3 pp band is wider than the noise on all three tiers and ALIGNED is a meaningful outcome rather than an artefact of a small sample. The frozen 400's n = 50 gave 5-7 pp, which is why those three tiers could not be decided there.
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim; the population is discovery data; no knob is tuned on it.
decision.not_authorized: No test contact, no mechanism arm, no Q8_0 flight (that is its own preregistered probe), no training-free policy fit, no edit to the locked SLURP cell, and no extension of tiers 1, 3, 4, 6 or 7.

why_one_run_id: All three tiers fly in ONE roster, ONE split identity hash and ONE run id because they are one population draw with tier as the stratum. contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's; a single roster satisfies that, which is why the tier-1 flight's two-run-id split (two different populations) does not recur here.
